subject: math
verificationNotes: Hand-authored; numeric answers checked with sympy.

items.prompt:
The three principles of experimental design are:
A) mean, median, mode
B) control, randomization, replication
C) bias, variance, error
D) sample, census, survey

steps: The three pillars. Key is B.

items.prompt:
A fake treatment used as a comparison is a:
A) factor
B) placebo
C) block
D) response

When neither subjects nor measurers know the treatment, it is:
A) single-blind
B) double-blind
C) matched pairs
D) a census

Randomization in an experiment is used to:
A) increase bias
B) balance other variables
C) choose the sample size
D) compute the mean

Each subject receiving both treatments describes a:
A) matched-pairs design
B) cluster sample
C) placebo
D) census

Replication mainly improves:
A) bias
B) precision
C) the population size
D) blinding

steps: More data, less variability. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Grouping similar subjects before assigning treatments (to reduce variability) is:
A) blocking
B) blinding
C) confounding
D) extrapolation

A control group's purpose is to:
A) receive the strongest dose
B) provide a baseline for comparison
C) increase the sample
D) randomize treatments
items.answer: B) provide a baseline for comparison

solution.answer: B) provide a baseline for comparison
